summary: Two demonstrated failures: undeclared cold-render dependencies and missing canonical source-bank replay. Tested mathematics, grading, batch variation, and UI rendering passed. The package remained unchanged.

math.details: No demonstrated equation, serialized-slope, or key errors across tested records and boundaries. All 40 practice-source choice images match canonical bytes.

variety.details: Thirty fresh records cover all six default templates; six boundary records cover additional outlier shapes and empirical scalings. No default-family restriction was demonstrated.

scope.details: Tested variations preserve dependence recognition, response format, and comparable workload.

grading.details: Native grader accepted 55 correct selections and rejected 220 alternatives, including controlled pairs; zero unresolved outcomes.

rendering.details: Actual UI rendered 17 records successfully. Representative screenshots, notation, image controls, and directional guides were inspected.

packaging.details: Cold rendering requires an undeclared absolute Python 3.10 executable and cached plotting libraries. Removing access to that executable causes failure; the external-enabled control succeeds. Publication-normalized relocation succeeds. Original package hashes are unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Relevant changes propagate through diagrams, explanations, and native grading; irrelevant changes preserve responses. All five batch records survive delivery without a demonstrated fixed-position shortcut. Selection rules were examined with captured-inventory and live-history limits recorded.
